about: Chart views (charts/core.js): window.IOChartViews[id] = {name, description, order, mount(env), unmount(env), on(kind, event, hit), update(env), sync(env), attrs, tip, icon}. One entry per proposal, pre-listed; the page loads charts/<file> only for entries with ready=true and lists every one that registered mount() in the bottom-right Prototype picker ('Charts'). c0 is registered by core.js itself (today's page: nothing enlarges).
